title: AI News Daily — August 30, 2026
summary: Sony Music and Warner sued Anthropic, alleging a "brazen campaign" of torrenting and scraping copyrighted songs to train Claude, with damages that could run into billions. Meanwhile, Anthropic's touted 25% Claude Code limit increase actually nets out to less capacity than users have today once a temporary boost expires. And Tencent released Hy4, an open-weight model that edged out GLM-5.3 and Kimi K3 on its own coding benchmarks.
